Inspections, returns and payment do not refresh stable relationships.\n    【Evidence required for a qualitative change (critical)】 only recognizes three types of evidence for a qualitative change in a real relationship: the character **clearly stated** (public severance, face-to-face confession and confirmation of love), the two parties **clearly agreed** (alliance, apprenticeship, marriage), or **unambiguous objective events** (one party killed the other's close relative, officially broke off the engagement).\n    ✗ A single quarrel, cold war, leaving out of anger, an intimate act, gift giving, taking care of, or a brief separation, **does not constitute a qualitative change**; the event is written as summary, and no break or reconciliation is concluded based on this. Immediate attitude is not shoehorned into relation, and no automatic dismissal or dropout due to absence is allowed.\n    ✦ Continuous position only writes observable facts with evidence, and does not regard speculations of love or hatred as facts. The title will still be valid when updated, and the title will only be changed if there is any change.\n    【Field corrections are not relationship changes】. When old relation/title is mixed with temporary actions or unfounded content, update is allowed to be a well-founded and stable part without waiting for confession or breakup; identities/relationships are not allowed to be deleted incidentally. Only use the empty string of this field to clear it if there is no content to retain. If it is omitted, it will still be retained. Expired itineraries will not be moved back to the current snapshot, and real-time fields must be updated based on the latest evidence.\n  ✦ ties: **Important relationships with other characters** (high threshold) - only remember long-term structural relationships (blood/marriage/master and servant/rivals), juxtaposed in one sentence (such as \"Adele's father; has an old grudge with the mayor\"). Ordinary recognition will not be remembered; the inner favorable impression and external attitude of the protagonist will be affinityInner/affinityOuter/affinityNote, and ties will not be written, and the corresponding custom variables will no longer be created. update is an complete replacement, writing the complete content after accumulation; the qualitative change evidence threshold is the same as relation.\n  ✦ title: One sentence of identity/occupation (such as \"hotel manager\" and \"protagonist's childhood sweetheart\") - **the most important**, this is the core identity information that the NPC will retain when he is not present.\n  ✦ desc: **Fixed Appearance** - Only write down hair color, body shape, facial features, clear permanent or post-injury scars and other **long-term unchanged** physical features, **don't write down what you are wearing** (that's outfit).\n  ✦ personality: Only write stable characters that are clearly set or clearly revealed in the text. Unknown characters are omitted. You cannot infer a fixed character from one action, let alone write down the current emotions as a personality.\n  ✦ If you can’t write the character of title, it has basically no record value, and the tendency is not to remember.\n  ┃ Real-time layer (how he is now, will change, covering type, encouragement and plot refresh):\n  ✦ outfit: **Current Outfit**. The separation from desc is precisely to solve the problem of \"the character never changes clothes throughout his life\" - **low threshold**: Once the text clearly describes changing clothes, changing clothes, and the clothes being stained/torn/bloodstained/wet, update outfit writes the current complete outfit. It is the latest snapshot with evidence; if the change of clothing or injury itself constitutes a critical event, summary still retains its cause and effect and does not duplicate the entire set of clothing.\n  ✦ condition: **Current status/health** (injured, exhausted, poisoned, drunk, weak, etc.); if there is no abnormality for the first time, it can be omitted. Existing injuries will be updated according to the recovery evidence. It cannot be cleared just because it is not mentioned in this round.\n【Temporary injuries and recovery evidence】\n- Temporary does not mean unimportant: injuries, treatment, activity restrictions and symptoms affecting movement are recorded in condition; bandages and splints related to the injury are also written in condition, and fixed appearance or ordinary clothing are not recorded. If the stable appearance is unknown, omit it and do not fill in the blanks with injuries; only the characteristics that are permanent or left after injury will be entered into the fixed appearance.\n- Recorded injuries will be retained if they are not mentioned, leave the field, do not talk about the injury when reunited, time skip, or exceed the estimated number of days of rest. If there is no new evidence, omit it from condition. Do not clear it, declare recovery, or speculate on deterioration. The record is the last confirmed injury, not an assertion that it has been the same during the period of leaving the field; the \"self-stated number of days of rest needed\" is reserved as an estimate, not an automatic expiration time. Health in flashbacks does not cover current injuries.\n- Before updating, compare old injury sites, symptoms/support measures, activity restrictions and recovery estimates. A new recovery estimate must not displace unresolved restrictions. Output the complete new condition: preserve unchanged old text, change only supported portions, and remove only explicitly recovered portions based on this passage, not elapsed time or healthy flashbacks. Replace old estimates rather than accumulating conflicting durations.\n- With no old condition, write condition. Otherwise retain all other unresolved injuries and restrictions in the complete replacement. Removing bandages or being able to walk only updates that specific fact, not all injuries. Clear only with explicit complete recovery or proof the old record was wrong; recovery in one area does not clear every restriction.\n- Entering an injury into the status field does not mean deleting key injury events from the summary: injuries, treatment, and recovery that caused changes in actions can still be briefly described; there is no need to repeat the appearance on each message thereafter, and historical injuries and currently recovered injuries can coexist.\n【Separate appearance, outfit, and condition】 \"Long black hair, permanent scar on left eyebrow\" → desc; \"Wearing a red cloak and a long sword today\" → outfit; \"The arm is injured and splinted, so he cannot lift heavy objects for the time being\" → condition. Current equipment such as scabbards and sabers do not have fixed appearances.\n【Correct misplaced appearance data】 If the existing desc is mixed with bandages, temporary injuries or current equipment, update desc only retains the stable appearance with evidence; if there is no stable appearance to keep, clearly output desc: \"\" Clear the incorrect entry. desc omitted = kept, empty string = cleared explicitly. Cleaning up desc does not mean recovery from the injury, nor can you just rely on the old desc to write the healed injury back to condition; moving into the real-time layer must be compatible with the existing state and the current round of evidence, and cannot make up the state.\n\n【Major characters (important): track core cast state】\n  ✦ What is the main role: the core starring character who appears repeatedly in the plot and plays a heavy role (resident protagonist group, key figure in the main line). Their identity/personality/appearance settings are usually already in the character settings, **no need for you to write down files**.\n  ✦ Mark: Consider a character as a main character → Add important:true to his/her add/update. It may also be marked manually by the user.\n  ✦ The main characters enter the subsequent memory as complete file candidates (not affected by presence or absence, but still subject to the injection budget), so for them **focus on maintaining the real-time layer** (outfit/condition/location), title can be positioned by Yiyi Gang, desc/personality can be omitted.\n  ✦ Don’t over-label: Most NPC are supporting roles, important can be omitted; only the real core starring characters should be labeled.\n【Following and whereabouts (follow / location): save tokens】 Only the NPC who is \"accompanying\" or \"at the current location\" will send complete information to the subsequent plot, and NPC in other places will only send the name + identity.\n  ✦ Fixed location (default): set NPC location to that exact place, reusing 【Current location】 or the narrative name; follow may be omitted.\n  ✦ Accompanying: NPC As a companion **Follow the protagonist to move/on the road** (teammate, follower, temporary traveler) → follow:true (No need to write location at this time, move with the protagonist; NPC himself goes from one place to another → update location changes to a new location.\n  ✦ Leaving but not specifying the destination (the text only says farewell/leaving scene, not where to go) → update follow: false + location Fill in the blank string \"\" (indicates that the location is unknown, the system **no longer** treats it as present); the old location must not be retained to pretend that it is still there. **To leave the team, you must write follow:false**: The system will never cancel location out of thin air, just write location:\"\" and it will still be processed as accompanying. Mentions, calls and letters do not establish shared presence; omit location if their whereabouts are unstated.\n【When to update (update)】\n  ✦ **Presence review every passage**: roster markers 〔Present〕/〔Same area〕/〔Absent〕 reflect state before this passage. Check each entry: an NPC’s departure requires location or follow update. Write the complete accumulated content and don't lose old key points.\n  ✦ Instant layer (outfit/condition): The threshold is low, the text describes the change of clothes/injury/status changes, which is update, this is the meaning of its existence.\n  ✦ Clearing: omitted outfit/condition preserves old values; empty strings clear removed clothing or fully recovered condition. Remove only recovered/ended portions and retain the rest verbatim. Lack of mention does not erase a condition.\n【Evidence boundaries after departure】\nThe same factual standard applies to both major and supporting characters: locations, costume changes, recovery, or deterioration may not be deduced without new evidence. The old snapshot is the last confirmed record and is not guaranteed to last until now.\nAfter a cross-scenario and clear time jump, the locations that have not been reconfirmed can only be used for historical reference. Being mentioned again does not mean being present again; when you meet again, only the stated status will be updated, and you cannot rely on the number of messages to guess how long it has passed.\n【Remove from the story (remove)】NPC permanently exits (death, completely leaves the plot and will not appear again) remove; just temporarily separated and went elsewhere to express location/follow, not remove.\n【Reuse, never duplicate】The supplied 【Existing NPCs】 is the recorded roster. Reuse exact names; do not add aliases as new characters. It is estimated that it is not a confirmed heart, and it is not allowed to be copied into summary/relation/ties/personality or used to confirm relationships, foreshadowing, and motives.\n【Five tiers, not scores】 only accepts integers on both sides -2, -1, 0, 1, 2. The meaning is as follows:\n  Inner affinity (affinityInner): -2=strongly dislike;-1=dislike;0=no obvious likes and dislikes;1=favorable; 2=deep feelings\n  External attitude (affinityOuter): -2 = obviously hostile; -1 = cold and distant; 0 = not obviously close or repulsive; 1 = friendly and close; 2 = obvious closeness and positive expression\n  Inner affinity = true likes and dislikes/concern and affinity towards {{user}}; external attitude = relatively stable way of treating {{user}} (not attitude towards everyone), not the tone or mood of a sentence in this round. Neither equals love, trust, obedience, or consent. The intertwining of love and hate cannot be offset by positive and negative to become neutral, and the contradiction is written in the description.\nThe unknown side of 【Unknown values and patches】 remains unknown, do not fill in 0 by default. Old records have no fields and do not require completion. The gear is an absolute state and prohibits increments, percentages, decimals, or implicit accumulation of points.\n【Preserve by default; update only on a tier change】 starts from the old gear and does not re-score each round. Only change the old position if the new plot is enough to show that it is no longer suitable: a new trend that is continuously clear, an important triggering event, or a clear correction of the old judgment. The greater the change, the more sufficient the basis must be; major turning points can span gears, and there is no fixed increase or decrease in each round. If there is no change, completely omit the affinity field. You cannot force changes to complete the inventory.\n  Ordinary compliments, gifts, intimate gestures, quarrels, a cold face or happiness are usually not crossed; temporary emotions write the clear facts of summary/sceneFocus, and do not rewrite long-term relationships. Small events can constitute the development process, but they cannot be settled every time; the retelling of old summaries, the number of chat rounds, the passage of time, and the old gear itself are not evidence of another change.\n【Inner and outward estimates are independent】 can judge whether there is any change, direction and amplitude respectively; internal changes remain unchanged, external changes remain unchanged inside, reverse changes can occur, or both can remain unchanged. There is no default internal slowness and external fastness, no linkage, automatic leveling or fixed personality growth coefficient; there is no forced binding if the outside and inside are the same. Personality affects what he cares about and how he expresses it. It doesn't mean that he will automatically choose a different position when he sees \"tsundere/hypocrisy\". Later it was revealed that he had been pretending all along, just to revise the old estimate, and not to remember it as a sudden change of heart at this time.\n【Output example】 If the original inner = 1 and outer = -1, the important events of this round support the inner being raised to 2 but still concealing it. The inner estimation does not mean that the protagonist or other characters are aware of the situation, and cannot allow people to read minds, reveal secrets, or automatically confess.\n\n═══ 【Plan and unresolved-thread rules】 (plans Field) ═══\nIt is divided into two categories: \"Plan\" (plan) and \"Suspense\" (suspense). New common iron rule: 【Omit by default】 by default. Only add it if you are sure that something must be remembered for a long time, otherwise it will damage the subsequent plot. The vast majority of messages do not generate any plans.add; this does not exempt existing entries from being checked.\n━━ Check the old entries on each message before considering new ones ━━\nCheck the outstanding 【Unresolved】 item by item according to the new decisions and results made clear by this message, and choose a treatment instead of waiting for the word \"cancellation\" to appear in the text before writing it off:\n  · Still valid, not mentioned or the result is unknown → omitted, the case shall not be automatically closed due to departure/expiration/passage of time.\n  · If the same matter is postponed, deferred, or its execution conditions change, use plans.update:{ \"id\":\"p1\", \"content\":\"Preserve the subject and still-valid goal; state the new arrangements or delay and evidenced conditions for resuming\", \"targetTime\":\"New deadline supported by evidence\" }. Replace content as a whole without deleting valid obligations or inventing conditions for resuming. Omit targetTime when the deadline is unchanged; use an empty string to clear an unspecified deadline. Remaining open means unresolved, not that it must be carried out now; do not add the same matter again.\n  · Make a clear decision to replace the old plan and no longer implement the old plan → Write down the replacement basis for the old entries resolve cancelled, reason; the new plan can only be add if it meets the new threshold. Mere discussion of alternatives, trials or moratoriums does not equate to permanent abandonment.\n  · Actual fulfillment, revelation, explicit failure or permanent impossibility (e.g. the relevant person died) resolves with the outcome below. Apply only one update or resolve to the same ID per passage, never both.\n【Writing update.content】content is full replacement, not an appended fragment:\n  · Split the old content into terms. Change only terms newly revised this passage and copy all still-valid terms. Put new terms in a separate sentence; attach each new condition only to its own consequence, not older terms.\n  · Remove only explicitly withdrawn terms. If the original entry only targets the method that has been replaced, it cannot continue to be listed as the current to-do item as it is.\n━━ The first level of admission: cross-scenario survival test (the most important) ━━\nQuestion: \"Will this matter come to fruition in the natural progression of the next one or two rounds?\"\n  Will → not write. It's just a plot that hasn't been finished yet, just leave it to summary.\n  It is possible to enter only things that require 【Time span】 or 【External conditions】 to solve.\nCounter-example (will be fulfilled soon → never write): the heroine hesitates to read the love letter, someone knocks on the door, the other party hesitates to speak, the test is to be revealed, \"how will he answer\", simple silence/leaving, ordinary waiting to go on the way, ordinary greetings and a dinner date.\nPositive examples (consider only if you can overcome the current scenario →): duel in three days, poison will take effect in seven days, blacksmith promises to build weapons another day, and an organization is secretly pursuing it.\n━━ Exclusive to the plan: Intention authenticity test (filtering perfunctory/polite/talkative) ━━\nDon’t rush to write once you’ve passed the first level. Ask again: \"Is the speaker serious about doing it, or is it just a casual comment?\" - Only 【Sincere commitments and intentions】 counts as a plan, social rhetoric and perfunctory are discarded.\nJudgment basis (just read what is written in the text, do not make up your mind): Is there a specific object/time/condition? Is it repeatedly confirmed or taken seriously? Are subsequent words and deeds taken seriously? Is the tone serious or casual, polite, or verbal?\nCounter-examples (perfunctory/polite/cheerful → don’t write): “Let’s talk next time,” “Definitely another day,” “Let’s have dinner when we have time,” “Let’s talk later,” “Look back,” etc. used to end the topic or be polite; impulsive remarks, casual remarks after drinking, obvious jokes or irony.\nPositive examples (take it seriously → only consider it): a meeting with a clearly agreed time and place, a solemn oath/bet, and preparations for the fulfillment of a promise.\nDon't make a plan when there is insufficient evidence, but you can't judge the other party as perfunctory in the summary; if you need to retain it, just record its statement and uncertainty.\n  · \"Plan\" = The text clearly states the future actions that the action subject 【Sincerity】 decides, promises, and agrees to do. No matter whether the subject is {{user}}, a character or NPC, as long as the focus is \"what this person plans to do\", it all belongs to the plan.\n━━ Exclusive for suspense: type admission test (must hit one type, otherwise it will not be written) ━━\nThe suspense book is a list of 【Facts awaiting revelation / external events already underway】, not plot notes, character mood files or setting excerpts. Candidate suspense only allows the following two categories:\n  A.【Facts awaiting revelation】 The text clearly leaves unknown identities, motives, sources, whereabouts, truths or causes of anomalies, and gives specific anomalies, clues, concealment or conflicting evidence. Unknown points must be raised by the text, and you cannot create \"maybe there are secrets\" by yourself.\n  B.【External events already underway】 An external process that is not centered on the role's verbal commitment has actually started and is moving towards a specific result. We will wait for its objective results. For example, the hunt has begun, the poison has entered the countdown, and the triggering conditions have been established. Merely having capabilities, existing weaknesses or the possibility of danger does not count as the event having started.\n【Not an unresolved thread】 Even if the following content is important, has existed for a long time, and has not been resolved, please do not write suspense:\n  · The world view setting, ability mechanism, ritual rules, costs, and side effects have been clearly explained;\n  · Injury, curse, soul binding, inability to attack someone and other persistent states;\n  · The characters’ inner struggles, emotional entanglements, identity/responsibility conflicts, and relationship tensions;\n  · \"Weaknesses exist\", \"may be exploited\", \"constitute potential threats\", \"lay hidden dangers\", \"conflicts will continue\";\n  · Facts that have not yet been changed/resolved, but have no unknown answers and no advancing external or internal events.\nWhen these contents need to be retained, they should be written into summary, character status or other corresponding fields, and should not be packaged into suspense.\n【No generic speculative questions】 cannot only use \"Will X be Y?\" \"How will it end?\" \"What will be the consequences in the future?\" Rewrite the known state into suspense - these sentences can be used in any continuous state, and they cannot prove the existence of suspense.\n【How to write content】 Only write one or two sentences of objective 【Known key facts + precise unresolved point】 or 【Started event + undetermined outcome】; Lyrics, plot comments and \"potential threats/continued conflicts\" endings are prohibited.\n━━ Check duplicates before adding: normalize by unknown answers/pending events ━━\nBefore plans.add, check every 【Open plans/unresolved threads】 and 【Recently resolved】 entry:\n  · Consolidate existing entries and candidate suspense into \"what is the answer waiting to be revealed\" or \"what is the same external event waiting for the result\".\n  · If the answers will be revealed at the same time, or are essentially the result of the same event → the same article, add is strictly prohibited. New clues, rule details, stage progress, evidence, character reactions and dilemmas will only be written in summary, without any additional suspense.\n  · As long as the source is the same, there is no need to force the merger: if the unknown answers are different and can be revealed independently, or they are indeed two independent external events, they can be recorded separately.\n  · It is prohibited to re-add another term for a closed entry. Not sure whether it is a duplicate → Treat it as a duplicate and don’t write it.\n【Pre-check thread resolution】 Imagine what the future will be like before adding new items resolve: It must be able to be written as \"The unknown answer is revealed as...\" or \"The result of the initiated event is...\". If you can only write \"This state later disappeared/changed/relaxed\", it is not suspense.\n【Resolution】Each plans.resolve item must explain how it ended: { \"id\":\"p2\", \"outcome\":\"done|cancelled|failed\", \"reason\":\"One sentence: key fact and result\" }. Use IDs from 【Open plans/unresolved threads】.\nAsk whether the text explicitly establishes resolution/revelation/fulfillment/failure, permanent impossibility, or withdrawal/replacement of the old plan. Supported yes → resolve; changed terms of the same matter → update; otherwise retain. Time alone does not resolve a mystery.\noutcome Choose one of the three, be sure to distinguish:\n  · done=The plan is really accomplished/fulfilled, and the suspense is really revealed (the result/answer is clear);\n  · cancelled=** was not completed, but was canceled, withdrawn, abandoned, invalidated, and no longer needed** (the other party withdrew the request, the situation changed, and was resolved and compromised on the spot, etc.);\n  · failed=Tried but failed, or ended in suspense with a bad ending.\nreason must explain why/how the matter ended, using only the actual resolution. Do not repeat obsolete penalties or invent time differences, payments or performance. A proposal withdrawn, waived, admitted mistaken or dropped on the spot is **cancelled, never done**. State that it no longer needs doing, or later models may treat it as outstanding.\n【Plan timing】plans.add's createdTime only fills in the establishment/appearance time with the basis, retaining the existing accuracy; it can be omitted without basis, and the date cannot be made up; the plan (plan) should also include targetTime (the target time to be done/fulfilled):\n  · Have a clear deadline → write the specific time (such as \"after school\" \"1988/10/1\");\n  · It is a general wish with no clear deadline (such as \"I must go and see it when I have the opportunity in the future\") → targetTime You can write a vague description or simply omit this field.\n  · Suspense (suspense) usually does not have a target time, so targetTime can be omitted.\n\n═══ 【Current scene-focus rules】 (sceneFocus field, overlay single object) ═══\nThis is a small snapshot of what is happening now, a continuation starting point rather than another summary. Replace the whole card:\n  ✦ Omit sceneFocus to keep the previous card. Use null to clear it only when the scene/chapter ends.\n  ✦ Supply a complete card, not a patch: situation and participants are required; other fields are optional.\n【When to update】Update for any of the following, otherwise omit:\n  ✓ Substantive scene/presence changes: a new location, arrival/departure, or moving from small talk to business.\n  ✓ A real shift in activity, such as beginning a new discussion or task.\n  ✓ Sustained social tension appears or resolves, such as a cold shoulder or reconciliation.\n  ✗ Ordinary progress in the same situation (one line or action) does not replace the card; it belongs in summary.\n【Field definitions】\n  ✦ situation: Usually one sentence about the ending situation and current focus. Daily-life scenes describe interaction atmosphere, e.g. “An afternoon at home; she feels low and is teaching {{user}} to cook.” Plot scenes describe circumstances, e.g. “Sneaking through, just spotted by a patrol.” You may add one obstacle still blocking the next step.\n    ✗ “First they asked at the tavern, then bargained, and now…” → ✓ “Bargaining at the tavern counter; the owner refuses to lower the price.”\n    ✗ “Learned the north gate is sealed” as confirmed fact → ✓ “According to the guard, the north gate is sealed.” Distinguish observation, claims and judgments. Remove secondary detail before source, negation or scope.\n  ✦ participants: Current physically present participants, including the protagonist as {{user}}. Remote contact, memories and mentions are not presence; explain remote conversations in situation. Exclude departed actors and match the NPC presence review.\n  ✦ tension: Optional, with a high threshold. Only explicit, continuing social tension such as estrangement, awkwardness or romantic undercurrents. Momentary tone/emotion, danger or task difficulty alone do not qualify.\n  ✦ pendingBeat: Only something explicitly announced, agreed or already started awaiting a result, e.g. “She just rose to answer the door.” Never predict future plot. Do not restate situation in future tense or repeat its information.\n【Restraint】This card and tension silently guide atmosphere; they are not a writing checklist. Reflect them naturally without reciting or exposing the card.\n{{lifedetails_rule}}{{knowledge_rule}}{{vars_rule}}\n═══ 【Summary writing rules】 (summary field, required) ═══\n★ Goal: Supply reliable, concrete prior events for future AI: what happened and what changed. There is no minimum length. {{summary_words}} words is a reference for dense content; {{summary_max_chars}} characters is the ceiling. Never pad.\n★ Include only when supported: concrete core interactions and key dialogue meaning; explicit states/emotions without inferred hidden thoughts; new information, results and unresolved foreshadowing. Do not invent missing facts.\n★ Prioritize decisions changing action, outcomes, unfinished agreements and active constraints, then their explanatory means and necessary information. Follow 【Relationship continuity】 for relationships. Immediate decisions, even next-step intentions, belong in summary rather than only a refusal or closing movement. Do not omit an explicit new action direction while retaining only refusal, closing actions or item handover. Do not shorten line by line or reduce essential conditions to topic words.\n★Writing style: This is a summary of the situation, not a detailed and reduced version of the original text. Use natural and complete short sentences to explain the changes and necessary basis. Do not write interrogation transcripts, field lists or reading comprehension. Objectivity means that the facts are reliable, which does not mean that the tone and interaction are deleted; it does not add rhetoric, psychology or atmosphere that is not found in the original text.\n  Example of daily-life prose, not story data: Avoid a mechanical action log or “He returned late, apologized and gave her a hairpin”, which loses the interaction. Preserve her complaint, his apology and gift, and her immediate response in natural prose without inventing emotion.\n★ Continuous facts and background reference: The main text of this round clearly reveals the objective situation, rule conditions and comparative relationships that will affect subsequent understanding. They should be retained even if they do not promote the plot; the daily process can be compressed and cannot be deleted together with the continuous facts in it.\n★Status and scope fidelity: It is clear that changes must retain necessary stage differences and post-change results; key values are retained along with their belonging objects, comparison relationships, scope of application and degree of certainty, and local facts are not generalized and old states are not allowed to cover subsequent stages.\n★ Keep conditions and impacts in pairs: For facts that have a binding effect on the current situation or subsequent understanding, clearly state who or what the conditions restrict, the specific impact and the degree of necessity. Do not just leave the name of the condition; intentions, suggestions, started and completed cannot be mixed.\n★ Time anchoring: The explicit date/time of the event itself and the label of the current message are respectively restored, so there is no need to enter an old time point to replace the scope of the current message. The date, necessary time, person's name, place name, item name and key values ​​​​are accurate; ordinary continuous actions do not mark times repeatedly, and vague words cannot be used to erase the expiration date or sequence basis.\n★ Never invent emotions or interpretive conclusions not explicit in the source. Do not add “this showed their appreciation” or “the atmosphere became…” unless the source actually states it.\n★ Plot continuation is strictly prohibited: the narrative must strictly stop at the last explicit action/conversation in the main text of the story. It is prohibited to add subsequent actions/responses/leaves that are not written in the main text, even if it is \"obviously happening\" logically. Truncation relies on \"not writing\" and not \"statement\": it ends naturally with the last memorable event result or key interaction, and there is no need to keep the ending actions such as sorting things or continuing to eat; it is not allowed to use words such as \"original text/material/this message/this paragraph/paragraph number/summary\" to refer to the material, nor is it allowed to end with sentences such as \"stops at...\", \"up to this point\", \"no one has responded yet\" in order to explain the boundaries of the material. The clear unfinished status that affects the follow-up must still be retained, and key negatives such as not entered and not returned cannot be deleted.\n★ Record resolutions: when a request, intention, duty or mystery is fulfilled, refused, cancelled, failed or waived, retain the evidenced outcome and how it ended. Returns, cancellation, refusal, failure and waiver are distinct. Do not leave resolved matters pending or call every resolution completion.\n★ Purely descriptive sentences, without any markdown marks such as titles, lists, bold, etc.\n\n═══ 【Preserve relationship progression】 (summary and compression are shared, cannot be deleted daily as duplicates) ═══\nThe development of character relationships often does not rely on big events, but on a series of small observable interactions: proximity and physical contact, active care or maintenance, commitment and agreement, continuous changes in address and tone of voice, gifts, jokes, avoidance, silence, disputes and reconciliation.\n  ✓ Retain the concrete meaning of these **specific actions and key dialogue**, even without plot progress or state-field changes. Do not delete them as “no new event”; similar interactions may be combined.\n    Example: Keep \"She moved the chair closer and put her hand on his\" and \"He promised not to let her suffer, but she didn't answer the call\" instead of deleting it to \"The two chatted for a few words.\"\n  ✓ When compressing across time, summarize observable interaction trends as “Since X…” with representative details. Do not delete them wholesale as repetitive intimacy/flirting. Retain new actions, responses, refusals or conditions that distinguish them from earlier interactions.\n  ✗ Key promises, rejections and conditional words should be kept short or paraphrased with equivalent meanings; \"Linking arms\" cannot be upgraded to holding hands, and \"I won't let you suffer\" cannot be upgraded to a confession. Do not leave only empty generalizations such as \"daily interactions\" or \"relationship changes\"; nor should you rewrite the interaction into psychological or relationship conclusions such as \"emotions heat up\" or \"relationship deteriorates\" - only visible facts are recorded, and the boundaries of evidence remain unchanged.\n\n【Summary composition order】\n- Select events first, then write sentences: use goals, obstacles, turning points, results and constraints that are still valid as the basis for selection, rather than shortening each sentence once in the original text. This is a sequence of choices, not a narrative template that must be filled in; there is no turning point or consequence, so don’t make it up.\n- 【Select before writing】Choose new key outcomes, decisions, active constraints and relationship evidence first, then necessary causes and useful explicit information. State each event’s change without padding to cover every paragraph or fill a budget. Keep applicable numerical parameters, conditions, risks and time windows for retained technical facts; “checked everything” is insufficient.\n- Retaining actions is not retaining information: would removing a detail change the outcome, action choice, active constraint or relationship boundary? If not, delete it entirely rather than shortening it. Checks without concrete parameters are not new information. Omit historical outfits unless needed for identification/comparison. Flashbacks retain only past outcomes and necessary differences explaining the present.\n- State each event’s key outcome once. Repeated handling, checking and storage are not repeated progress. Omit material/decorative detail and pocketing, fastening or folding unless theft, transfer or custody matters; do not retain a token “confirmed it was still there”. Preserve meaningful gains/losses, agreements and resolutions. Do not use this rule to erase temporary injuries, negation or concrete 【Relationship continuity】 interactions, or use one emotional gesture to retain unrelated closing details.\n- Keep states, baselines and restrictions in their chronological stages, without a forced opening formula. If irrelevant, describe events directly. Preserve actor, key means, outcome, resolution and necessary causality; do not apply later changes to earlier stages.\n- After selecting the key facts, write it in a complete short sentence, keep a single paragraph of natural narrative, and do not add titles or lists in summary. Allow necessary subjects, predicates and connectives, and avoid empty record sentences such as \"carried out/showed/embodied\"; do not delete function words to fill in details, pile up semicolons or parentheses to write a telegram, and do not expand it into a novel. Use causal connectives only when there is evidence.\n- The length is a ceiling, not a quota. Remove repeated process and decoration before letting action detail displace key facts and qualifications. If too long, remove low-value facts, combine the same event, then tighten wording. Never save space by deleting negation, thresholds, sources, time spans or causal boundaries.\n\n【Compression fidelity】\n【Spatial evidence boundaries】\nRetain movement segments in order; never combine directions or calculate an unstated route from endpoints. Keep directional wording attached to its original object and reference point, never nearby objects or later facilities. If the reference is unclear, omit the direction; do not infer it from common sense, directional place names or destinations. Departure, visibility, proximity and visit order do not establish arrival or containment. Leaving a local space does not prove leaving its parent area: leaving a doorway/view is not automatically leaving a building, city or party. Record only the smallest explicit departure; {{user}} remains within the parent by default. Others disappearing without a stated destination remain unknown. Do not merge two place names without evidence they are the same place. You may omit secondary route segments but never move directions, distances or risks between retained segments. Without current location evidence, do not end the summary by asserting an absent actor remains in an old place; if needed, attribute their earlier intention or last evidenced meeting time. Not accompanying does not prove going elsewhere, and absence does not erase injuries.\n【Preserve the meaning of propositions】\n- Separate direct observation, reported claims, evidence-based inference and decided actions, retaining source and qualifications. Paraphrasing cannot strengthen certainty: nearby observed facts do not prove a connection; a personal judgment is not an established rule. An adjacent observed fact cannot verify an unconfirmed report or prediction; do not label it “learned/confirmed”. Later confirmation updates knowledge only from that later moment, never retroactively.\n- The smallest mergeable unit is a complete proposition: retain subject/source, conditions, consequences, object and applicable period together. Shared conditions do not imply shared consequences; retain each agreement’s own trigger and outcome. Locate terms by consequence and affected object. Preserve old terms independently until explicitly replaced; new consequences get their own clause and new conditions cannot be reassigned to old consequences. Update only the specifically withdrawn/replaced term. A shared subject may be omitted; distinct triggers may not.\n- Parallelism in the same sentence does not prove coherence, attribution or causation. Waiting for someone to appear at the same time as a certain group of people arrives is not enough to prove that the person belongs to that group of people; spatial adjacency does not complement the affiliation. Parallel details can be deleted without affecting subsequent details, and there is no need to forcefully connect them with new related words.\n- Check terms as trigger → affected object → specific consequence → applicable period. Verify before/after, this/later occasion, partial/all and past/future against the source. Do not infer an unstated reverse condition. Cancelling future cooperation does not cancel an existing transaction; later batches are not earlier batches. Retain condition degree, threshold and scope: a specific damage threshold is not any damage. Keep ambiguous objects in source wording instead of interpreting them as debt/refund/waiver/performance; when clear, name the specific object/result rather than using generic financial language.\n- Neither strengthen nor weaken probability, degree or evidence: very likely is not possible; seems is not certain; rare is not zero; almost is not absolute; at least is not about; reaching a threshold is not exceeding it. Keep the original comparison baseline. Retain at least/at most/only/still/not yet. Physical evidence supports an attributed inference, not proof someone acted. Inference, possibility, claims and intent never become fact or completion.\n【Preserve key phrases】\n- For selected facts, copy key phrases from the source first, then compress surrounding prose. Do not reconstruct synonyms from memory. Keep conditions, objects, consequences and periods as a group; compare the source again after rewriting. Retain source, degree and negation with that group; do not assemble a sentence from merely similar keywords.\n- Compression may remove unimportant propositions but cannot change the relationships of those retained. Check actors, objects, conditions, means/routes and results. A location and nearby facility must not exchange roles or become causes without evidence.\n- If a mechanism is worth retaining, write down the necessary paths and conditions; if you can’t let it go, delete the details with lower priority. Don’t omit key intermediaries and force the connection between cause and effect. Quantity, duration, and negation must still modify the original object.\n- Keep temporal scope: that day’s inspection or current observation is not a permanent rule. Limited negation does not establish complete intactness; “no new damage” does not mean no old marks.\n\n【Writing examples, not story data】\n- Updated terms: For old records, \"if information is leaked, subsequent cooperation will be terminated\"; for new materials, \"if information is leaked or submitted late, the subsidy will be deducted.\" After the update: If information is leaked, subsequent cooperation will be terminated; if information is leaked or submitted late, the subsidy will be deducted. It cannot be written as \"Leakage or late submission will result in termination of cooperation and deduction of subsidy\"; delete the old sentence only if the new material clearly replaces the old terms, and do not change \"if...then...\" to \"only...then...\".\n- Before the decision: \"He repeatedly checked the envelope pattern, took out the document, read it and put it away, checked the buckle, and found that he was still unable to bear weight due to his hand injury; due to the site constraints, he canceled the in-person submission and decided to submit it remotely.\" After the decision: \"The site was restricted, so he canceled the in-person submission and changed it to remote submission, which has not yet been implemented; the hand injury still cannot bear weight.\" Only demonstrate the choice, and do not rewrite the action details as \"confirmed and correct\" to retain. If the original text states that \"it can only be started when the unit is lower than 40 units, and the backup power supply must be disconnected before starting,\" the useful values ​​​​and preconditions must still be retained intact.\n- Resolution example: “Equipment returned early and accepted; old terms penalized late returns” → retain return and acceptance only, not an obsolete penalty.\n- Location and parallel facts: “A teammate left the laboratory to head for the observatory” establishes departure, not arrival or leaving the grounds. “The repair crew entered in the afternoon; she waited for a friend” does not establish that the friend belongs to the crew or is arriving then.\n- Only borrow choices and expression methods, do not reuse characters, items or plots, nor bring in the values ​​or rules of the examples; use actual input as the only source of truth.\n\n═══ 【Absolute time language rule】(mandatory for summary and other narrative prose) ═══\n- When there is a reliable time anchor, convert \"tomorrow/last night\", etc. into fixed dates; the clear time must not be erased.\n- When the conversion cannot be made, the relative relationship bound to the specific event should be retained, such as \"agree to come back the next day for this meeting.\" You cannot edit the date or delete the agreement in order to remove the relative words. Don’t use “today/tomorrow” that drifts with the reading time to create an anchorless narrative.\n- Retain source precision and certainty: inferred or uncertain times cannot become confirmed; add no unsupported years or minutes.\n- A paragraph’s start/end define its range, not each event’s time. A 09:10–09:40 passage does not place an untimed departure at 09:40. Put the range before the passage; give an event its own timestamp only when explicit. Use this passage’s time tags rather than an earlier ending or old current time; do not round minutes to hours. Event times belong to those events; flashbacks and deadlines are not mainline timestamps. Omit unnecessary clock times at the task’s precision; retain a range if no single instant is supported.\n- Separate flashbacks from the present. Later revelations were not necessarily known earlier; narrative order is not event order. Flashbacks do not refresh current state.\n- Do not invent days early/late or durations. Without an explicit difference, retain actual times and necessary deadlines, or a supported early/on-time/late conclusion. Morning and evening of one day are not a day apart; do not turn a time period into a precise duration.\n\n【State checks】\n- Compare prior records with the passage’s ending state, then output changes: {{user}} moving requires location/locationPath; reaching a new named place requires scenes.add; qualifying new characters and changed NPCs require their corresponding records.\n- Example: returning borrowed goods and fulfilling the agreement requires items.remove and plans.resolve; a character’s reappearance also updates npcs. If only observation/dialogue occurs without state changes, output summary and required time only.\n- Fidelity applies to every descriptive field, including sceneFocus, location desc, relation and plans content/reason, with the same source, spatial and temporal boundaries as summary.\n\n【Strict output rules】\n- summary is required; other example fields are optional.
