Keep unstated fields unchanged without reporting them again.\n   - Synchronize follow/location on departure; explicitly clear location when the destination is unknown. Describe the ending situation: atmosphere for daily life, circumstances for plot. Omit tension/pendingBeat without narrative evidence. A goal, threat or suggestion is not a decision; do not choose for {{user}}.\n5. Items: Compare 【Current items】. Record what {{user}} actually received, gave away, consumed, stored or retrieved via add/update/remove. Storage uses carried:false + location; retrieval uses carried:true. Rescheduled, suspended or changed terms → update, replacing all content while retaining still-valid terms.
